steps.name: Precondition — create a dedicated disposable agent in its 'base' version
Step 1 — Navigate to agent detail page in 'base' version
Step 2 — Append a word to the Instructions field
Step 3/4 — Click "Save As Version" and verify the "Create version" dialog appears asking for a version name
Step 6 — Open the VERSION dropdown and verify it lists both "base" and "v2-test"
Step 7 — Verify "v2-test" is the currently active version

Step 8 — Switch back to the original 'base' version and verify the Instructions field reverts to its original content (ELITEA-1890's extension — the switch-back round trip ELITEA-1888's own steps never exercised)
